title: Hardened Pair-Class Signature Derivation
starting_point: V1696.4 showed retained pair equivalence classes are promising, but raw D1/D2 vectors and scalar support labels were too weak.
claim_boundary: Derivation protocol only. No execution, no compatibility claim, no retained field-law validation.

problem_to_fix.D1D2_old: raw D1/D2 vectors were appended to Sig([p]_R), but D1D2-profile scramble was weakly rejected.
problem_to_fix.support_old: support/provenance was represented as coarse scalar class id, but support shuffle was not rejected.
problem_to_fix.required_change: make derivative response and support/provenance intrinsic cochain signatures.

hardened_signature.formula: Sig_H([p]_R) = (role, orientation, J_D[p], G_D[p], C_support[p], A_order[p], G_pair_context[p])
hardened_signature.role: product role label or declared role morphism
hardened_signature.J_D[p]: derivative-response Jacobian signature of Phi_oplus for pair p
hardened_signature.G_pair_context[p]: signed pair-Gram context relative to other retained product roles

derivative_response_signature.definition: J_D[p] = [D1_response[p], D2_response[p], D12_cross[p]] under declared perturbation basis
derivative_response_signature.Gram: G_D[p] = J_D[p]^T J_D[p], normalized by trace or Frobenius norm
derivative_response_signature.why: A scramble of raw D1/D2 vectors should change the Jacobian/Gram structure even if vector norms are preserved.

support_provenance_signature.definition: C_support[p] is an incidence cochain over support/source/provenance nodes touched by pair p.
support_provenance_signature.why: Support is not a scalar label; it is a local incidence structure. Shuffling labels without preserving incidence must fail.

retained_order_signature.definition: A_order[p] is an adjacency/cochain signature of retained-order dependencies for the pair.
retained_order_signature.allowed_language: retained-order, pruning-order, dependency sequence, order ledger

equivalence_rule.statement: p ~_R q iff Sig_H([p]_R) and Sig_H([q]_R) agree under declared role/orientation morphisms and normalization.
equivalence_rule.distance: d_R(p,q)=weighted block distance over role, orientation, J_D/G_D, C_support, A_order, and G_pair_context.
equivalence_rule.important: weights are declared before execution and not tuned after nulls.

coarse_class_rule.undefined_case: If fine signatures do not form a compatible family, the coarse class is undefined rather than forced.

required_nulls.N_D1D2_profile_scramble: preserve D1/D2 norms but scramble derivative-response Jacobian/Gram.
required_nulls.N_support_class_shuffle: preserve scalar support counts but shuffle incidence cochain.
required_nulls.N_order_adjacency_scramble: preserve order counts but scramble retained-order adjacency.
required_nulls.N_role_preserved_vector_scrambled: preserve role labels and vector norms but scramble signature body.
required_nulls.N_local_signature_preserved_class_broken: preserve local signatures but break quotient aggregate compatibility.
